thread:
maria: FYI customer reported a sudden spike of decrypt failures after last night's key rotation. They say some API calls get AccessDenied even though the same principal worked earlier.
aj: ugh. any error samples? stack traces or raw aws error?
maria: pasted from support ticket: "AWSKMSDecrypt failed: AccessDeniedException — encryption context 'client:id' missing". They included a request id.
sam: that sounds like encryption context mismatch. Did we change STS session tags or the way we call KMS in the rollout?
maria: Ops deploy last night included STS session tagging to propagate tenant_id as session tags. telemetry shows a subset of decrypts hit 403s around 02:12-02:28 UTC.
lia: possible repro: when we assume role with session tags, KMS conditionals on "kms:EncryptionContext:tenant" may not match if tags weren't added to the Encrypt call earlier.
aj: can we get CloudTrail events for Encrypt/Decrypt for that key and timeframe? need to check if encryption context was present at Encrypt time.
maria: grabbing CT now, attaching minimal lines in thread: ```
eventTime: 2025-06-14T02:15:10Z
eventName: Encrypt
requestParameters: {"encryptionContext": {"tenant":"acct-52"}}
requestID: abc-123
---
eventTime: 2025-06-14T02:16:02Z
eventName: Decrypt
requestParameters: {"encryptionContext": {}}
requestID: def-456
```
sam: there it is — Decrypt missing ctx. That would explain AccessDenied if key policy uses condition on encryption context.
lia: question for infra: did the STS session tagging rollout accidentally drop the ctx on proxy path? infra-oncall: investigating. My initial hunch: our request builder for decrypt path strips the ctx if the session tag header exists to avoid duplication. That would be a bug.
infra-oncall: reproducing locally with a test role and our proxy. Command used: ```
AWS_PROFILE=test aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://c.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:... --encryption-context Tenant=acct-52
``` got AccessDenied when proxy header X-Session-Tags set.
aj: ok we have a reproduction. Next: is this a code rollback or config fix?
maria: customer is worried about audit logs / retention: they say some messages might be permanently unreadable and need to know if data loss occurred.
lia: from an auditor POV, we should provide: (1) full CloudTrail evidence for Encrypt/Decrypt including requestParameters, (2) list of affected key ARNs and time windows, (3) mitigation plan (re-encrypt or fallback).
sam: short-term mitigation: add an automatic passthrough that preserves encryption context on decrypt requests (hotfix). Medium: update proxy to merge session tags into encryption context rather than strip.
sec-bot: INC-2025-459 created for this escalation and assigned to eng-infra. ETA initial triage 30m. :rotating_light:
maria: please escalate to KMS/compliance for guidance on re-encrypt and retention window. We may need to rotate or rewrap with a temporary key.
lia: also notifying customer success: ask customer for a list of affected object ids and any business windows where reads failed. We'll need consent for rewrap if PII.
aj: config patch ready, will run canary on staging then cut hotfix to prod if tests pass. I'll post the PR and rollback plan.
infra-oncall: PR: https://scm/repo/pull/3287 — changes: preserve encryptionContext when X-Session-Tags present. Rolling to canary now.
maria: thanks. after canary we'll collect post-fix CloudTrail samples and update customer + compliance.
lia: assigning follow-ups: rewrap playbook (lia), audit packet (maria), postmortem template (sam).
maria: keeping thread updated. tagging @security-leads once we have audit packet. :white_check_mark:
